appDescription: A shared trip destination app that records passenger discussions, recommends places from the current conversation, and keeps previously saved visits.

function.name: START_CABIN_CONVERSATION
function.description: Open the app and start capturing the passengers' discussion for the current destination planning conversation.

function.name: RECOMMEND_CABIN_PLACES
function.description: Recommend places matching the passengers' recorded preferences, or read the current place recommendations and their reasons if they are already up to date.

function.name: SHOW_SAVED_CABIN_PLACES
function.description: Open the list of previously saved visits with their conversation summaries and reasons for choosing each place.
